expected.title: [ASTRA] Preserve Python SDK HTTP errors for non-object JSON
expected.body:
The Python SDK now raises `BoTTubeError` when an HTTP error contains a JSON array, null, string, number, or boolean. Both ordinary requests and multipart uploads preserve the HTTP status, decoded detail, and original exception cause. Object-shaped errors and successful response parsing retain their existing behavior; streaming uploads are unchanged.

Adds 30 parametrized regression and compatibility cases. Recorded validation on base `e4dcd51fa42c1ca34f7738bf94ceb1cc37b6c2dd`: the complete SDK subset passed all 42 tests twice on CPython 3.13.5 / pytest 9.0.2; the new cases produced 16 failures and 14 passes before the change. Four real loopback HTTP GET/multipart cases also passed after the change. Python 3.9–3.13 grammar parsing, compilation, and whitespace checks passed. These are the existing recorded results; tests were not rerun during this packaging step, and no hosted CI result is claimed.

Preserves the exact patch from operation `astra-py-new-20260907`: https://github.com/woahwhattheheck/commons/blob/9ea61a32210fd5bb214b784c93fc8d03cb111d7d/revenue/bounties/astra-py-new-20260907.patch

Both deployment-drift policies inventory only `bottube_server.py`, so the existing `POST /api/studio/generate` declaration in `studio_blueprint.py` is reported as missing code. The original sentinel suite at the merge revision used by #2207 reproduced 2 failures / 37 passes.

## Changes
- Add `studio_blueprint.py` to both explicit source inventories.
- Refresh two stale inventory-count snapshots: 26 documented operations and 353 declared application operations.

expected.title: [Codex] Fetch every GitHub bounty issue page
expected.body:
The bounty index stopped after the first 100 matching issues from each repository. Fetch subsequent issue pages while GitHub advertises a next page, retaining the bounty/open filters and excluding pull requests on every page. If a later request fails, retain earlier results, warn, and continue with the next repository.

Validation: the full suite passes 233 tests; the focused suite passes 65. Two of the three new regressions fail against the original source (2 failed, 1 passed). Tests cover a second page beyond 100 issues, pull-request filtering, a later-page timeout followed by another repository, and stopping without an extra request when the last page is exactly full. HTTP responses are mocked. The full run has one unchanged test escape-sequence warning.
